scope: Implementation-before contract for the K15 isInitial gap: 30-day first-meet window, earliest provable owner interaction, first-meet designation and protection. Documentation only; no source, tests, migration, route, model, account, device or database change.

grounding.reference: xuexi/surfcore 59ec3066 memory-card.js: only owner interactions; 30-day window tiers first10/mid10/late10/after with 0.9/0.55/0.3/0.03 stable probability; manual designateFirstMeeting/clearFirstMeeting; protectedInitial prevents hard forget.
grounding.v2_data: memory_entries has kind/content/person_id/session_id/importance/pinned/clarity/recall_count/decay_steps/last_seen_at and created_at from the scoped base; no source/tags/scope/is_initial/first_met columns. source_anchors can carry message_id/action_id/object_id/document_revision_id/manual_audit_id. message_id -> messages.run_id -> runs -> qq_runs (person_id/sender_id/binding_id) -> qq_bindings.scene -> people.owner_id can prove an owner interaction. Memories without anchors cannot prove it.
grounding.v2_scoring: score_memory already supports is_first (+30, kind=first, first&&owner -> 100 pinned); current remember passes is_first=False. decay protects pinned or importance>=65; probabilistic isInitial would not necessarily reach that protection.
grounding.no_migration_option: Auto-detect only the earliest provable owner interaction and reuse first&&owner -> 100 pinned; no new columns, tables, routes or migrations. Probabilistic tiers can be audit-only.

No change to is_first default, score authority, memory kind CHECK, decay protection or prefix until the owner decides.

recommendation: Start with the conservative zero-migration option: mark only the earliest provable owner interaction as is_first, reuse first&&owner -> 100 pinned protection, and keep tier/probability audit-only; add manual designation and probabilistic tiers only after an owner decision and, if needed, an A-assigned migration.
